description: The successor machine starts in \(\mathrm{scan}\). Scanning a mark rewrites it and moves right; scanning a blank writes a mark and moves left in \(\mathrm{back}\). In \(\mathrm{back}\), a mark is rewritten and the head moves left; a blank is rewritten and the head moves right in \(\mathrm{halt}\). Both rows in \(\mathrm{halt}\) are missing.
